In the current BB sidebar with the icon rail, the content column sits 8px from the rail and 8px from the content panel, the collapsed rail mode keeps a 12px gutter, project tree rows have equal left/right insets and a consistent indent step inside their cards, and the usage tracker is visible inside the footer card.
- 2026-10-12T15:32 shell-footer-tracker-basis: Usage tracker in the sidebar footer sized by content, visible again. On desktop the usage tracker item in the sidebar footer card takes its content width (not the usage-tracker plugin's 180px basis), sits at the card's right end and its reading and count are fully visible inside the card.
- 2026-10-12T15:25 shell-footer-card-fit: Sidebar footer card: usage tracker fits inside the card on desktop. On desktop the sidebar footer tool card keeps every item, including the usage tracker reading and count, inside its rounded edge on one row; the icon buttons compact instead of the tracker being squeezed.
- 2026-10-12T15:20 shell-sidebar-list-inset: Project list on the same inset as nav rows and footer card. On desktop the project-folders list (.pf-tree: New project button and .pf-project cards) uses the same left and right inset as the nav rows and the footer card (8px from the sidebar surface edge and from the content panel edge).
- 2026-10-12T15:14 shell-sidebar-one-surface: Sidebar as one light surface with even inner spacing. On desktop the whole sidebar is one light rounded surface (no gray band from [data-sidebar=content]) and its nav rows, list and footer card sit on one even inner inset, with the footer card's visible left, right and bottom spacing equal.
- 2026-10-12T15:04 shell-sidebar-top-regression: Fix 0.5.7 regression: sidebar panel under the macOS chrome row. The desktop sidebar panel again starts right below the macOS chrome row (BB's own top) and ends at the window bottom, so the sidebar surface shares the content panel's top and bottom edges and its extension under the content panel is not visible above or below it.
- 2026-10-12T15:01 shell-sidebar-seams: Sidebar tuck without seams: shared top/bottom line with the content panel. On BB's desktop app the sidebar surface tucks under the content panel with real geometry (no box-shadow copy): one color with no seam at the top-left join, the same top and bottom edges as the content panel, and the sidebar footer card and left column ending on the same bottom line.
- 2026-10-12T14:50 shell-grid-fix-live: Shell grid fix: real desktop selectors, inset fits the window, no square corner. On BB's macOS desktop app the sidebar/content join has no square corner, the content panel's top aligns with the sidebar surface below the chrome row, and the content panel fits inside the window so the composer and its chip row are fully visible with an equal bottom gutter.
Files of this area: package.json, src/theme/base.css, theme.test.ts, themes/pokecut.css

- `src/theme/base.css`: the sidebar footer card sits `--pk-gap-card` above the sidebar surface's bottom edge, matching its side padding. Header and footer blend into the surface color, so no band hangs below the content inset.
- `src/theme/base.css`, desktop sidebar footer: `li.usage-tracker-sidebar` is `flex-shrink: 0` with `margin-left: auto`, so the usage tracker keeps its content width and is not squeezed. The footer's tool icon buttons are 28px squares with `padding-inline: 0` and absorb the width pressure. The footer card uses `overflow: hidden` so nothing paints past its rounded edge. The `--pk-gap-card` 8px insets are unchanged.
- `src/theme/base.css`: the desktop sidebar nav rows, the list and the footer card all sit on the same `--pk-gap-card` inner inset. The panel's 1px right border is removed, so the footer card's visible left, right and bottom spacing are equal, each `--pk-gap-card`, measured to the surface edge and to the inset's left edge.
